bullets.id: Emas spot sempat jatuh ke $3.830 pada Senin, terendah sejak Oktober 2025, sebelum ditutup di $3.862,9 (turun 0,49%), terendah dalam sekitar 14 bulan menurut Bloomberg Technoz. Pidato Ketua Fed Kevin Warsh soal AI tidak memberi sinyal baru tentang bunga, jadi tekanan dari ekspektasi kenaikan bunga tetap. Perak anjlok 3,6% ke $46,98.
bullets.en: Spot gold fell as low as $3,830 on Monday, the lowest since October 2025, before closing at $3,862.9 (down 0.49%), its lowest close in about 14 months according to Bloomberg Technoz. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech on AI gave no new signal on rates, so pressure from hike expectations stayed in place. Silver slumped 3.6% to $46.98.

bullets.id: CME FedWatch memberi peluang 95% untuk kenaikan 25 bps pada Desember. Dolar di dekat level terkuat sejak April 2025, sementara yield Treasury 10 tahun turun tipis ke 5,131% dari puncak 5,174% Jumat. Trading Economics mencatat emas turun 6,7% dalam sebulan dan sekitar 31% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 pada Januari 2026.
bullets.en: CME FedWatch puts the odds of a 25 bp December hike at 95%. The dollar is near its strongest since April 2025, while the 10-year Treasury yield eased to 5.131% from Friday’s 5.174% high. Trading Economics shows gold down 6.7% over the month and about 31% below its $5,608.35 record from January 2026.

bullets.id: FinanceFeeds mencatat support di sekitar $3.834 lalu $3.800, dengan resistance di $3.900 dan $4.010. Agenda: penjualan ritel Oktober Selasa pukul 20.30 WIB (konsensus naik 0,6%), risalah rapat Fed Kamis dini hari WIB, dan klaim pengangguran Kamis malam.
bullets.en: FinanceFeeds lists support around $3,834 then $3,800, with resistance at $3,900 and $4,010. Agenda: October retail sales on Tuesday at 8:30 a.m. ET (consensus +0.6%), the Fed minutes on Wednesday afternoon ET, and jobless claims on Thursday.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram turun Rp7.000 ke Rp2.515.000, sementara buyback turun Rp20.000 ke Rp2.278.000, sehingga spread melebar ke Rp237.000 (sekitar 9,4%). Galeri24 tetap Rp2.456.000 (buyback Rp2.312.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS tetap Rp2.480.000 (buyback Rp2.286.000, spread sekitar 7,8%).
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price fell Rp7,000 to Rp2,515,000, while buyback fell Rp20,000 to Rp2,278,000, widening the spread to Rp237,000 (about 9.4%). Galeri24 held at Rp2,456,000 (buyback Rp2,312,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS held at Rp2,480,000 (buyback Rp2,286,000, spread about 7.8%).
